podcast.body: Bobby Vee's first single, which was about to come out when he was picked up to round out the bill on the Winter Dance Party tour after the plane crash. "A new young singer was picked up to round out the bill on the next gig, a young Minnesotan Holly Sounder-like called Bobby V, whose first single Suzy Baby was just about to come out."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
